messages:
Dana: Thanks for staying on the all-hands thread — wanted to drop the follow-ups from the reliability segment and the RCA link.
Dana: RCA is here: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237 (summary at top). Please read before EOD.
Mohan: Quick Q — are the action items prioritized? hard to tell from the doc.
Dana: Yes — we put P0/P1 tags in the doc. TL;DR: P0 is the router bug + misrouted fallback, P1s are observability gaps and autoscaler tuning.
Elena: Who owns the P0 rollback mitigation? I thought that was infra but last night it looked like runtime.
Priya: Runtime team owns the hotfix (Rory is the lead), infra handles the routing rule change that's the temporary fallback.
Rory: Confirming — runtime will ship a staged patch by tomorrow 10:00 PT. Infra will keep the temporary routing override until patch is validated.
Sam: Can we get the SLO hit window for customers? I want to scope support comms.
incident-bot: incident-237 status changed -> postmortem published. link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Mohan: For support comms, suggest one consolidated email and one public status page update. Claire, can you coordinate?
Claire: Yep, I can do that. I'll draft the status page message and the customer email; will share here for review by 11:30 PT.
Priya: Obs gaps: missing token-level breakdown for the fallback region. Owner is Elena (obs). Elena: assigning a ticket and will follow up with sample queries we need.
Elena: I already opened RED-7123 and attached trace snippets. Putting a dev checklist in the ticket.
Dana: Action item list (short): 1) Runtime hotfix (Rory) — target 03/24 10:00 PT. 2) Routing override removal plan (Infra: Priya) — target 03/24 12:00 PT after verification. 3) Observability ticket RED-7123 (Elena) — triage by EOD. 4) Customer comms (Claire) — draft by 11:30 PT. 5) Post-deploy verification plan (Mohan + Sam) — signoff window 30m.
Mohan: For verification, suggest a smoke script: `./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1 --concurrency 5` and a token-level comparison against baseline.
Rory: I'll post patch PR once tests pass. PR link will be added to the RCA and pinged here.
Sam: After PR lands, I can run the smoke script and run a 15-minute soak on staging. If green, push to canary.
Priya: Small ask from infra: if routing override needs to remain >24h we should schedule a maintenance window. Ops prefers <12h.
Dana: Noted. We'll aim for the 12h window. If runtime patch slips, we'll escalate to execs.
Elena: One more ask: can we get a snapshot of sequence-length distribution during the event? I put sampling hooks in RED-7123.
Mohan: I'll export the distribution and attach to the ticket by 09:00 PT.
Claire: Drafts inbound in ~45m. Will ping for quick approvals.
Dana: Thanks team. Please mark the RCA checklist items you own in the doc so execs can review. If you can't meet the target, speak up now so we can reassign.
Rory: ACK, will update the RCA and add PR link.
Priya: ACK, will prepare rollback playbook for infra (short steps) and paste into the doc.
Sam: I'll confirm the soak result window in this thread after running the script.
Mohan: I'll also monitor metrics (p50/p95/p99) and post snapshots here.
Dana: If nobody objects, I'll summarize these actions at 11:45 PT and close the follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
Elena: No objections. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder: status page update due in 1 hour for incident-237.
Claire: Posting draft now -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/237-draft
Dana: Great. We'll sync on any edits and finalize. Thanks everyone.
